articles.rawDescription: Ancient Maya communities made extensive use of liquid mercury and a red, mercury-containing pigment called cinnabar to decorate buildings, pottery and burial sites. And that pollution may have spread even farther into their territory and caused the collapse of two lake ecosystems, according to a study published in the journal Science Advances.

articles.rawDescription: A new study published in Environmental Research Letters has found little evidence that hyperscale data centers cause significant heating of surrounding land.
